import csv, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
variants = site / 'fixtures/before-variants.csv'
images = site / 'fixtures/before-images.csv'
baseline = site / 'fixtures/after-shopify.csv'
entry = site / 'verify_example.py'
companion = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/delivery-rehearsal/director-manual-comparison-control.json')
receipt = {'scope': 'Synthetic offline test with the published worked-example schema. No live import, delivery, or payment was tested.', 'draft_sha256': json.loads(companion.read_text())['draft_sha256'], 'inputs': {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (entry, site / 'verify.py', variants, images, baseline, companion)}, 'runs': {}}
def run(name, source, output):
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(entry), str(source), str(images), str(output)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    receipt['runs'][name] = {'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'variants_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    return result.returncode

def write_csv(path, rows):
    with path.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as file:
        csv.writer(file).writerows(rows)

if run('baseline', variants, baseline) == 0:
    with variants.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as file:
        source_rows = list(csv.reader(file))
    with baseline.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as file:
        output_rows = list(csv.reader(file))
    sku_column = output_rows[0].index('Variant SKU')
    barcode_column = output_rows[0].index('Variant Barcode')
    candidates = [row for row in output_rows[1:] if row[sku_column] and row[barcode_column]]
    pair = next(((left, right) for left in candidates for right in candidates if left[sku_column] != right[sku_column] and left[barcode_column] != right[barcode_column]), None)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        reordered = Path(directory) / 'reordered-variants.csv'
        write_csv(reordered, [source_rows[0], *reversed(source_rows[1:])])
        run('reordered_source_rows', reordered, baseline)
        if pair is None:
            receipt['gap'] = 'Baseline has no pair with distinct nonempty SKUs and distinct nonempty barcode values.'
        else:
            left, right = pair
            receipt['swapped_values'] = [{'sku': left[sku_column], 'before': left[barcode_column], 'after': right[barcode_column]}, {'sku': right[sku_column], 'before': right[barcode_column], 'after': left[barcode_column]}]
            left[barcode_column], right[barcode_column] = right[barcode_column], left[barcode_column]
            swapped = Path(directory) / 'swapped-output.csv'
            write_csv(swapped, output_rows)
            run('swapped_output_barcodes', variants, swapped)
else:
    receipt['gap'] = 'Baseline failed. Modified inputs were skipped.'
path = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/delivery-rehearsal/director-verifier-controls.json')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
